description: Progressive Capability Delegation (PCD), RFC-001 v1.2.0: a capability-based security and non-destructive fault isolation standard for autonomous agent frameworks. Version 1.2.0 expands the Genesis Trust Ceremony (Section 5.1) into a layered bootstrap model and updates one row of the Section 6 threat matrix. It supersedes v1.1.0.
title: Progressive Capability Delegation: A Capability-Based Security and Non-Destructive Fault Isolation Standard for Autonomous Agent Frameworks
